newsitem.title: CHINA: China Securities acquires 37 brokerage offices.
newsitem.headline: China Securities acquires 37 brokerage offices.

text.p: China Securities Co, one of China's biggest securities houses, has acquired 37 securities brokerage offices, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.

The acquisition, which still requires the approval of the People's Bank of China, will bring the number of the firm's branches to 87, giving it the third largest branch network of any brokerage in China, the newspaper said.
The newspaper gave no other details, but China state banks were earlier ordered to close or transfer their securities subsidiaries by the end of last year.
